system.description: Your ability to adhere to a surface with chakra is exceptionally refined. When Wall or Water Walking, you no longer spend additional movement per foot traveled, allowing you to move at your full speed on walls, ceilings and across water. Additionally, you no longer make saving throws and checks to resist being knocked prone, pushed or pulled at disadvantage while Wall or Water Walking.
